description: Eight stereo channels feeding two send buses, with two returns and a chain input that are added to make the mix output; several of these can be placed side by side and their sends add up along the row

params.text: Sets how much of that channel goes to the A send, 0 to 1
Sets how much of that channel goes to the B send, 0 to 1

inputs.text: The left side of that channel; with nothing patched to the right jack beside it this one feeds both sides of that channel
The right side of that channel
A signal added straight into the left mix output, untouched by anything on this panel
A signal added straight into the right mix output, untouched by anything on this panel
The left side of whatever comes back from the effect on the A send; it is added into the left mix output
The right side of whatever comes back from the effect on the A send; it is added into the right mix output
The left side of whatever comes back from the effect on the B send; it is added into the left mix output
The right side of whatever comes back from the effect on the B send; it is added into the right mix output

outputs.text: The left side of the A send: every channel at its A amount, added, plus whatever the A send of a YAMANOTE to the left has already gathered, clipped at ±10V
The right side of the A send, gathered the same way
The left side of the B send, gathered the same way
The right side of the B send, gathered the same way
The two returns and the chain input added together and clipped at ±10V

notes: the eight channel inputs never reach the mix output. They only feed the two send buses, so the mix output stays silent until something is patched into a return or into the chain jacks.
place a Runner, Facehugger or Ovomorph immediately to the right and cables appear on their own, carrying the A send into it and its output back into the A return.
place a second YAMANOTE, a U8, an ALEXANDERPLATZ or a SHINJUKU immediately to the right and this module's mix output is cabled into that module's chain inputs on its own.
with another YAMANOTE immediately to the right, this module's send and return jacks are hidden, because the sends gather along the row and come out of the rightmost one.
